tiptap_body.circle_ios_fallback_text:
Hi all,

I’m in the process of creating the SOPs for Delivery to Success and Claude came back with an interesting question following Prompt 1:

Does this boundary feel right? The assessment we just did covers the full 5 Rs journey, which technically spans Delivery to Success, Success to Lead, and Success to Market per your Business Process Framework. I'm proposing we keep it all under Delivery to Success as one cohesive process since these are tightly coupled for a solo practice. Want me to split them or keep them together?

Has anyone else had this come up? My assumption is to split them up to stay true to the framework we’re using, but given the realities of my current solo operation, it does make sense to condense in some cases, such as this.

update: I went ahead and just had Claude split them up…it amounted to the final blueprint (client growth and advocacy) being shifted into the next process, which feels correct.

Appreciate the feedback!
